facts: Normal redemption is described as immediate, but product liquidity shortages and delayed processing are explicitly possible.
canRedeem only reports current operability; the redemption command returns request acceptance, while PAID is the terminal history status.
The API is asynchronous and does not publish a worst-case redemption completion bound.
Flexible assets can be auto-redeemed for Spot and Convert, but that does not prove availability as margin for the current perpetual product set.

retained_scope: Hourly read-only APR, quota and operability observations only; no subscription, redemption, account projection, Reference mapping or capital action.
reconsideration_condition: Re-evaluate only when a qualified Alpha creates measurable cash demand or independent venue evidence closes stressed redemption and margin availability semantics.
